attributes.name: Improvised Rock
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, bury this card to use your Strength skill + 2d4. If this is not your first combat check of the turn, add 2d6 instead. After playing this card, you may succeed at a Strength or Survival 6 check to recharge this card instead of burying it.

When you defeat a barrier that has the Lock, Obstacle, or Trap trait, recharge this card to draw an item from your discard pile.
